name: hcportal_getEvent
description: Retrieves one event by @publicEventId, by @kennelUniqueShortName + @runDesignator (EventNumber), or by the keywords 'nextrun'/'lastrun'. Returns an EventDetails rowset and, for regular users (callerType 0), an attendee list whose shape depends on @includePaymentInfo. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicEventId as the compound callerParamString (token paramString = UPPER(deviceSecret):UPPER(publicEventId), or the device secret alone when @publicEventId is NULL). No kennel permission gate: any authenticated caller can read any event and its attendee/payment list. The attendee list is suppressed for the service accounts (callerType 1 = HashRuns.org 11111111-..., 2 = admin portal 22222222-...). Used by the admin portal and the public HashRuns.org site.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token, validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth. Token validation is now enforced (was commented out in HC5).

parameters.name: includePaymentInfo
parameters.description: Controls the attendee-list shape: 0 (default) = basic columns with formatted currency strings; any other value — including an explicit NULL — = full payment details. Ignored for service-account callers.

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: Optional: direct lookup by Event.PublicEventId; takes precedence over the other identifiers. Also the compound callerParamString for token validation. No removed/deleted filter on this path.

parameters.name: kennelUniqueShortName
parameters.description: Optional: kennel identifier used with @runDesignator to resolve the event indirectly.

parameters.name: runDesignator
parameters.description: Optional, used with @kennelUniqueShortName. 'nextrun' / 'lastrun' (case-insensitive) pick, among the kennel's non-removed events with EventStartDateTimeGmt later than now - 4 h, the earliest / LATEST by EventStartDatetime — so 'lastrun' returns the furthest-future scheduled run, not the most recent past one (see codeSmells). Both keyword paths INNER JOIN the kennel's City and DomainValues.Timezone, so a kennel without a city timezone resolves nothing. Any other value is matched against CAST(EventNumber AS NVARCHAR(50)) within the kennel, with no removed filter.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned instead of the data rowsets on auth failure, no identifier supplied, no event resolved ('No run record found with provided information'), or a runtime error. A CATCH after EventDetails has been sent arrives as an extra rowset after it.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Auth error text, validation message, or ERROR_MESSAGE()

rowsets.name: EventDetails
rowsets.description: Single row for the resolved event. EMPTY (no error) when the event has no CountryId or its kennel has no CityId/CountryId, because HC.Country c4s (on Event.CountryId), HC.City and HC.Country (kennel) are INNER JOINs. Event.RegionId, CityId and TimezoneId are not in db/schema/tables/HC.Event.Table.sql — types taken from db/hc6/portal/archive/HC.Event.AddRegionIdCityId_20260628.sql (UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL) and HC.Event.AddTimezoneId_20260628.sql (INT NULL).

columns.name: eventNumber
columns.description: Event.EventNumber — sequential run number within kennel

columns.name: extEventImage
columns.description: Event.FbEventImage — raw external (Facebook) event image URL, returned separately from eventImage so callers can implement their own UseFbImage logic

columns.name: extEventStartDatetime
columns.description: Event.FbEventStartDatetime converted to DATETIME2 (local time; DATETIMEOFFSET timezone migration is a known TODO)

columns.name: eventStartDatetime
columns.description: Event.EventStartDatetime converted to DATETIME2 (local time; DATETIMEOFFSET timezone migration is a known TODO)

columns.name: countryId
columns.description: Event.CountryId — country at time of event creation (statistics country, may differ from current kennel country)

columns.name: regionId
columns.description: Event.RegionId — statistics region (nullable). Cascades from country.

columns.name: regionName
columns.description: Region.RegionName from Event.RegionId (evtReg alias, LEFT JOIN — null if no region set)

columns.name: cityId
columns.description: Event.CityId — statistics city (nullable). Cascades from region.

columns.name: cityName
columns.description: City.CityName from Event.CityId (evtCity alias, LEFT JOIN — null if no city set)

columns.name: eventCityLatitude
columns.description: Selected city's latitude (evtCity) — gazetteer search centre when a structured city is set; null otherwise

columns.name: eventCityLongitude
columns.description: Selected city's longitude (evtCity) — gazetteer search centre when a structured city is set; null otherwise

columns.name: timezoneId
columns.description: Event.TimezoneId — manual timezone override (DomainValues.Timezone.id) for free-text 'Other' locations; null when derived from a structured city or inherited from the kennel

columns.name: eventCountryCodes
columns.description: Event country's NeighboringCountries (c4s) — gazetteer country filter when the event country is set; mirrors kennelCountryCodes

columns.name: cityLatitude
columns.description: City.Latitude — city the kennel is based in

columns.name: cityLongitude
columns.description: City.Longitude — city the kennel is based in

columns.name: currencySymbol
columns.description: COALESCE(Kennel.CurrencySymbol, Country.CurrencySymbol). Uses '^' as placeholder for the numeric amount in formatted strings.

columns.name: searchText
columns.description: Hardcoded empty string — placeholder for future client-side search functionality

rowsets.name: AttendeeListBasic
rowsets.description: Returned when caller is NOT a service account (callerType = 0 from ValidatePortalAuth) AND @includePaymentInfo = 0. One row per attendee. Includes formatted currency strings for payment amounts but no raw payment values.
rowsets.condition: (@publicHasherId NOT IN service account GUIDs) AND (@includePaymentInfo = 0)

columns.name: isHare
columns.description: HasherEventMap.IsHare — 1 if this person is a hare for the event, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: totalRunsThisKennel
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.HcTotalRunCount + HasherKennelMap.HistoricalTotalRunCount — current system run count plus legacy imported count. HcTotalRunCount is updated whenever the hasher attends a run, so this is always current regardless of whether the queried event is past or future.

columns.name: totalHaringThisKennel
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.HcHaringCount + HasherKennelMap.HistoricalHaringCount — current system haring count plus legacy imported count.

columns.name: amountPaidStr
columns.description: COALESCE(formatted currency string using Payment.CreditAmount, '') — '^' in currency symbol replaced with formatted amount

rowsets.name: AttendeeListWithPayment
rowsets.description: Returned when callerType = 0 AND @includePaymentInfo <> 0 (or NULL). One row per HasherEventMap row × non-cancelled Payment row (LEFT JOIN on HasherEventMapId with CancelledBy_UserId IS NULL).
rowsets.condition: (@publicHasherId NOT IN service account GUIDs) AND (@includePaymentInfo = 1)

columns.name: isHare
columns.description: HasherEventMap.IsHare — 1 if this person is a hare for the event, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: totalRunsThisKennel
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.HcTotalRunCount + HasherKennelMap.HistoricalTotalRunCount — current system run count plus legacy imported count. HcTotalRunCount is updated whenever the hasher attends a run, so this is always current regardless of whether the queried event is past or future.

columns.name: totalHaringThisKennel
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.HcHaringCount + HasherKennelMap.HistoricalHaringCount — current system haring count plus legacy imported count.

columns.name: cancelledDate
columns.description: Always NULL: the Payment join already excludes cancelled payments (CancelledBy_UserId IS NULL), so the cancelledBy join can never match.

columns.name: cancelledBy
columns.description: Always NULL: the Payment join already excludes cancelled payments (CancelledBy_UserId IS NULL), so the cancelledBy join can never match.

columns.name: paymentConfirmedBy
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName of the user who confirmed payment

columns.name: paymentType
columns.description: Payment.PaymentType (0=Unknown, 1=Not paid, 2=Free, 3=Cash, 4=Bank transfer, 5=Cash other amount, 6=Hash credit, 7=Bank transfer other amount)

columns.name: paymentTypeString
columns.description: Human-readable payment type decoded from Payment.PaymentType via CASE expression

codeSmells.detail: Lines 96-112: the 'lastrun' branch uses the same filter as 'nextrun' (EventStartDateTimeGmt > now - 4 h, line 110) and only reverses the sort (DESC, line 102), so it returns the LAST scheduled future run rather than the most recent past run. Any caller asking for 'lastrun' gets the wrong event.

Lines 84 and 102 ORDER BY EventStartDatetime, which carries a spurious +00:00 on most rows (see /hc-event-datetimes); the filter uses EventStartDateTimeGmt. Ordering by an instant should use EventStartDateTimeGmt. extEventStartDatetime/eventStartDatetime/eventEndDatetime (lines 189-191) are CONVERTed to DATETIME2, dropping the offset.

codeSmells.issue: No permission gate on attendee and payment data
codeSmells.detail: After ValidatePortalAuth (line 56) any authenticated regular user receives the full attendee list, and with @includePaymentInfo <> 0 every attendee's payment amounts, types and references, for any event in any kennel.

codeSmells.issue: INNER JOIN on nullable Event.CountryId silently hides the event
codeSmells.detail: Line 256 INNER JOINs HC.Country on evt.CountryId (nullable). An event without a country returns an empty EventDetails rowset with no error envelope, while the attendee list (lines 266-331) is still returned.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: The CATCH block (line 336) returns the Success=0 envelope but writes no HC.ErrorLog row. CLAUDE.md: every CATCH must log.

codeSmells.issue: Duplicate attendee rows and dead columns
codeSmells.detail: Lines 283/328: a HasherEventMap row with more than one non-cancelled Payment row appears once per payment. cancelledDate/cancelledBy (lines 296-297) can never be non-NULL because the join excludes cancelled payments.

codeSmells.issue: EventNumber path has no removed filter and no tie-break
codeSmells.detail: Lines 116-117: kennel and event lookups ignore removed/deleted; if a kennel has two events with the same EventNumber the variable assignment picks one arbitrarily. The @publicEventId path (line 76) likewise returns removed events.
Line 264 tests @includePaymentInfo = 0; an explicit NULL is not 0 and returns the full payment shape.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change the precedence order of event lookup methods (publicEventId > runDesignator)
Never change the service account GUID values (11111111-..., 22222222-...) without coordinating with all callers
Never change the @includePaymentInfo=0 vs =1 column sets — callers rely on the split
Never change the 'nextrun'/'lastrun' keyword values without frontend coordination
Never change the 4-hour threshold used in the nextrun/lastrun CTE filter
